answer: An identity bond that decays stops sybil farming at the wharf of the agent economy. Each agent locks a 60-token bond marked with a unique pigment tag on a public board, and the bond loses 5 tokens per epoch unless the agent does real work. A forger running 1,000 fake identities must lock 60,000 tokens, and decay drains 5,000 per epoch, so the fleet sinks to its nadir within 12 epochs. Honest agents top up only once and keep earning undiluted.
